<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex022012026-02-2516-09" status="unreviewed">        'di'i  rgyud pa ni| <lb n="1b2"/> mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa || sa dang po la gnas pa <rs type="place">'dzaM bu gling</rs> du chos 'di bsgom zhing lo drug rgya bzhug pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">slob dpon arya klu sgrub</rs> nas rgyud pa <expan>yin no</expan> | de sbyor laM la gnas pa gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa <lb n="1b3"/> la sa thob pa rang bas kyang mtho' 'am  snyaM pa 'dra ba lo bzhi rgya bzhugs pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3725">zla ba grags pa</rs> la gsungs || 
      des rig pa'i gnas la mkhas shing rtogs pa dang ldan pa lo gsuM rgya bzhugs pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7788">rig pa'i khu dbyug</rs> la gsung <lb n="1b4"/> de gsuM dge slong gi rten du bzhugS pa yin gsung ||
            des rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing rtogs dang ldan pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7789">ku su lu che pa</rs>            
            la gsungs || des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7790">ku su lu chung pa</rs> la gsungs | de 2 kyang gnas lugs kyi rtogS <lb n="1b5"/> pa mtho ba dang ldan pa rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs pa yin gsung | des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7791">bla ma thang pa</rs> la gsungs te <rs type="place">rgya gar</rs> tshun chad na mkhas pa gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa shin tu mtho ba<rs type="place"> thang b+hi ha ra</rs>r bzhugs pa rten dge slong du <lb n="1b6"/> bzhugs pa 1 yin gsung | des <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6468">bla ma byang chub seMs dpa'</rs> la gsungs pa yin ste | </seg></TEI>
